definitions.explanation: A corridor or roofed passage that links two buildings or two wings of a building, typical of schools, hospitals, temples, and inns.

examples.japanese: {渡|わた}り{廊下|ろうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: To walk along the connecting corridor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本館|ほんかん}→本館：21133_honkan⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{新館|しんかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{渡|わた}り{廊下|ろうか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧つながって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The main building and the annex are joined by a corridor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{渡|わた}り{廊下|ろうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}って→通る：01243_tooru⟧⟦{体育館|たいいくかん}→体育館：03111_taiikukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: On rainy days we go to the gym by way of the covered walkway.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧ (to cross over) + ⟦{廊下|ろうか}→廊下：05005_rouka⟧ (corridor). In Japanese schools the {渡|わた}り{廊下|ろうか} between the classroom block and the gym or another wing is a familiar place, often open at the sides.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {渡|わた}り{廊下|ろうか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧つながる: to be joined by a corridor
- {渡|わた}り{廊下|ろうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧ / ⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧: to go along the corridor
